title: Nox At10 Luxury Genius 12k Alum Xtrem Lite By Agustin Tapia 2026 - Nox
description:
NOX AT10 LUXURY GENIUS 12K ALUM XTREM LITE BY AGUSTIN TAPIA 2026 - The racket that is going to become one of the most desired. They were crying out for it, a racket like Tapia's but lighter, suitable for everyone. 12K carbon in its manufacturing and reduced weight.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

NOX AT10 LUXURY GENIUS 12K ALUM

PLAYER TYPE

The AT10

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

Developed together with Agustín Tapia, this more agile version incorporates the key elements of the Luxury 2026 range, adjusted to a reduced weight of between 355 and 365 grams, ideal for players looking for maneuverability without neglecting that desired firm touch after the hit.

As a total novelty this 2026 season, Tapia's official shovel this year becomes 12K carbon, and this model could not be less. Made with the best carbon fiber present in the brand, specifically 12K Alum Xtrem Carbon, which will offer us a solid, resistant and stable structure.

One of the technologies that it incorporates on the surface is the Dual Spin system, designed to facilitate effects with greater ease and control.

The newest technology this season is the Weight Balance system, a system of counterweights that we can place in the upper part of the frame. These pieces must be purchased separately, they do not come with the shovel and we can change the weight and balance as we wish.
